correctness.rationale: Matching lower trace-norm witness (explicit repeated eigenvalue and 2x2 spectrum) and upper PSD Gram factorization (explicit two-block PSD matrices for each k regime) prove the exact norm over complex matrices for every n>=1 and 0<=k<=n. All boundary cases and row duplication are handled analytically. Supplementary numerical test of 895 assertions in finite dimensions confirms, not replaces, proof.
